messages:
maya: Kickoff — CredHub pilot experiment. TL;DR: 2-week playbook testing 50 free credits + curated prompt templates in webinar follow-up. Goal: increase 7-day activation from 9% -> 14%.
enrique: Love it. What's the funnel? landing -> webinar -> credit email -> promptpack -> CTA
maya: Exactly. We want to A/B two email copy variants and 2 promptpack difficulty levels (starter / power).
sam: Metric defs: activation = first generated response >= 20 tokens? or completion + saved prompt? Need clarity.
olivia: Let's use "first generation returned & user clicks Save Prompt" as activation. Cleaner signal for downstream usage.
maya: ok saved prompt = activation. primary metric: % activated in 7 days. secondary: avg tokens used per activated user.
enrique: ops ask: can we route webinar registrants into CredHub cohort and pre-seed the 50 credits? I can wire that to the inbound flow.
sam: snippet for the routing rule:
```
if (source == "webinar") assign_cohort("credhub_wk1");
seed_credits(user_id, 50);
track_event("credit_seeded", {cohort: "credhub"});
```
olivia: For email variants: A: "Your 50 credits + prompt pack — start building" B: "Start faster: 50 free credits + tips from our lab" Keep subject lines short.
maya: Also add a prompt templates quickstart inside the product modal post-login. 1 click "Try Starter" or "Try Power".
marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: webinar follow-up drip to run 24h, 72h, 7d after event. I'll send the campaign list at 2pm PST.
enrique: Need landing copy + CTA. I'll draft and post in #marketing-assets by EOD. Anyone can tag edits.
sam: Experiment tracking: create experiment id CH-2026-03, instrument events: credit_redeemed, prompt_used, prompt_saved, activation. I'll add to telemetry.
olivia: Benchmarks: run small bench cohort (n=200) to get baseline for token usage and response latencies for prompt templates.
maya: Quick asks: enrique please wire routing + seed credits; sam add instrumentation; olivia own promptpack; I'll coordinate copy + webinar slide mention. Sync at 10am tomorrow.
enrique: On it. tagging @sam @olivia.
maya: :raised_hands: thanks team — rough timelines pinned. If anyone has concerns about credit abuse we can throttle by account age.
sam: Add rule: only seed if account_age_days > 1 or email_verified == true. small PR coming.
olivia: Cool. I'll prepare 6 prompt starters and share samples.
maya: End of thread.
